sloka: एहि सिद्ध अर्थ विजय जयन्त अशोक नन्दन ।श्रूयताम् इतिकर्तव्यम् सर्वान् एव ब्रवीमि वः ॥२-६८-५॥
transliteration: ehi siddha artha vijaya jayanta aśoka nandana ।śrūyatām itikartavyam sarvān eva bravīmi vaḥ ॥2-68-5॥

translations.english: Calling Siddhartha, Vijaya, Jayanta, Asoka and Nandana, Vasistha said, All of you listen to what is required to be done (by you).
